verdict.rationale: LightSprint's live preview lets teammates "hop in, watch it build, and weigh in" on tasks still in progress, which suggests feedback can reach an agent mid-build. Nothing explicitly says that feedback steers the running agent session rather than being comments or triggering a new task. Missing for 10: explicit docs on sending follow-up instructions to an active agent session, confirmation the session continues without restart, how steering messages are handled, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
